headline: Bank of Japan Issues Monetary Policy Statement and Adjusts ETF Sales Plan
summary: The Bank of Japan issued its monetary policy statement and economic outlook report on inflation. It also announced amendments and decisions regarding the pace of sales for its ETF and J-REIT holdings.
why: The Bank of Japan manages monetary policy and vast asset holdings in the world's fourth-largest economy. Policy decisions and balance sheet adjustments directly impact global bond yields, currency flows, and equity markets.

impacts.name: Japanese Yen
impacts.why: Monetary policy statements and economic outlooks shift rate expectations and currency valuations.
